K1.text: SEC-03 fixed: the jwt callback calls sessionStillValid on every auth() (deleted account or sessionsValidFrom watermark ends the session, moved by a password reset), and SEC-08 fixed: the magic link now lands on a page and is spent by a POST action; checkout/pay/reset tokens are hashed at rest.

K2.text: SEC-07 fixed: requireStaffActor itself checks needsMfaEnrollment from the database on every call (allowUnenrolled only for the /mfa screen), so actions, CSV routes and /api/facilities/* refuse unenrolled staff, not just the layout.

K3.text: Prior sweep of all route handlers and 'use server' files stands (staff routes call requireStaffActor/getAdminActor, webhook verifies signature, cron is bearer-checked, public actions are token-gated); admin by-id pages/actions re-spot-checked and still guarded; not every service body was re-read.

K4.text: SEC-02 fixed: rateChangeEcho now runs assertFacilityAccess before reading and uses lease.findFirst({id, facilityId}), returning null (same as missing); two other echo reads (ledger confirmCorrection, ledger-exceptions subject) are bare lease.findUnique by id but sit behind an actor-scoped domain preview/service that has already refused, so I treat them as not exploitable though not independently traced.

K5.text: SEC-04 and SEC-05 fixed: checkout starts (per IP and per unit type), promo checks and magic-link/reset requests (per email and per IP) are limited via RateLimitEvent rows in the database, alongside the existing login and lead-capture limits; loopback/no-IP callers are deliberately unlimited.

K6.text: Pay/checkout/reservation links are hashed, expiring and revocable, /pay is in NOINDEX_PREFIXES so the proxy stamps X-Robots-Tag, the page is force-dynamic, and the global Referrer-Policy is strict-origin-when-cross-origin (SEC-06); no explicit Cache-Control: no-store on /pay and the referrer policy is not strictly no-referrer, but the token path is not sent cross-origin.

K7.text: SEC-06 fixed: next.config.ts headers() applies Referrer-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options nosniff, CSP frame-ancestors 'none', X-Frame-Options DENY and HSTS (2y, includeSubDomains) to /:path*; SEC-09 also fixed the proxy matcher skipping dotted paths.

K8.text: Cron uses timingSafeEqual and fails closed without CRON_SECRET, demo gate uses a constant-time compare, no secret NEXT_PUBLIC_ vars, no tracked secrets; single-use magic/reset tokens ride in the query string (now only to a confirm page, spent by POST), which is inherent to those links.

K9.text: SEC-01 fixed: signature checked on the raw body with Stripe's timestamp tolerance, fails closed (503) without the secret, event id claimed by primary key, and on a collision the row is re-read and only treated as duplicate if processedAt is set, so a failed first apply is re-applied on Stripe's retry; failure stores the error and returns 500.

K10.text: Sign-in email throws in production when the send fails; the link-to-console log fires only when RESEND_API_KEY is unset (dev), and real sends are gated by environment with a kill switch.

K11.text: Still no schema-validated env at boot: no zod/createEnv anywhere, process.env read raw across ~dozens of files; .env.example exists and lists app vars.

K12.text: Tests use their own schema and e2e runs against a production build, but the suite is redirected onto a schema of the same (possibly cloud Neon) DATABASE_URL/DIRECT_URL and no code-level guard refuses a remote DB URL in vitest/playwright (only the seed script guards).

K13.text: audit_log has BEFORE UPDATE/DELETE row triggers and a TRUNCATE trigger that raise, and no application code updates or deletes audit rows.

K14.text: OPS-01 fixed: vercel.json has an ignoreCommand that anchors to the repo root, diffs from VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA, excludes docs and *.md and exits 1 (build) on failure (it also deepens the shallow clone first); port 3000 is the accepted incumbent hardcoded in playwright baseURL; cron is constant-time, fail-closed and now daily (HEAD f80e5f8, 2026-11-10).
